source: 22. Why does attaching a citation to an answer not prove that the cited source supports the claim or that the model actually relied on it? [Advanced - Attribution] A citation can fail in several different ways. The cited passage may not entail the claim; a claim may have no citation at all; the citation may support only part of a compound sentence; or the model may generate a correct-looking citation after producing an answer from parametric memory. ALCE evaluates cited generation and separates answer quality from citation quality. Later work distinguishes citation correctness - whether the source supports the claim - from citation faithfulness - whether the model genuinely relied on the cited evidence rather than post-rationalizing. In production, preserve a mapping from claims to source spans, check citation entailment or support, measure coverage of externally verifiable claims, and make source opening easy for users. A URL next to a sentence is metadata, not proof. Attribution is its own evaluation target. [20][21]
zh: 22. 为什么在答案中附上引文并不能证明引用的来源支持该主张或该模型实际上依赖于它？ [高级 - 归因] 引文可能会以多种不同的方式失败。所引用的段落可能不包含主张；一项主张可能根本没有引用；引文可能仅支持复合句的一部分；或者模型在从参数记忆中生成答案后可能会生成看起来正确的引文。 ALCE 评估被引生成，并将答案质量与引文质量分开。后来的工作将引用正确性（来源是否支持该主张）与引用忠实性（模型是否真正依赖于引用的证据而不是事后合理化）区分开来。在生产中，保留从声明到源跨度的映射，检查引文蕴涵或支持，测量外部可验证声明的覆盖范围，并使源开放对用户来说变得容易。句子旁边的 URL 是元数据，而不是证据。归因是其自身的评价目标。 [20][21]
